softwareInnerHero.title: Comprehensive Electrical Power System Analysis, Design, and Operation
paragraphs: ETAP (Electrical Transient Analyzer Program) is a leading software platform for the design, simulation, operation, and automation of electrical power systems. Trusted by engineers globally, ETAP provides an integrated suite of tools to model, analyze, and optimize power networks, ensuring their reliability, safety, and efficiency across various industries, including utilities, industrial plants, oil & gas, renewable energy, and critical infrastructure.
softwareInnerHero.imageAlt: Comprehensive Electrical Power System Analysis, Design, and Operation

title.before: ETAP empowers electrical engineers and power professionals to:

items.title: Model and Design Power Systems
items.body: Create detailed one-line diagrams and intelligent models of AC and DC power systems, incorporating a vast library of electrical components and equipment. This forms the foundation for all subsequent analyses.

items.title: Perform Comprehensive Electrical Analysis
items.body: Conduct a wide range of critical studies including:Load Flow Analysis: Determine voltage drops, power losses, and power factor to optimize system performance.

items.title: Short Circuit Analysis
items.body: Calculate fault currents based on industry standards (ANSI, IEC) to ensure proper equipment sizing and protection.

items.title: Arc Flash Analysis
items.body: Evaluate arc flash hazards to enhance personnel safety and ensure compliance with safety regulations.

items.title: Protection Coordination
items.body: Design, analyze, and verify protective device settings to ensure selective tripping and system reliability.

items.title: Motor Starting Analysis
items.body: Simulate motor starting effects on the power system to prevent voltage sags and equipment damage.

items.title: Transient Stability Analysis
items.body: Assess system stability and dynamic performance under various disturbances.

items.title: Optimize System Performance and Reliability
items.body: Identify potential bottlenecks, predict equipment behavior, and optimize system configuration to enhance operational efficiency, reduce downtime, and improve overall system reliability.

items.title: Facilitate Digital Twin Creation
items.body: Develop a digital twin of your power system for real-time monitoring, predictive maintenance, and operational decision-making, bridging the gap between design and live operation.

items.title: Ensure Compliance and Safety
items.body: Adhere to international electrical standards and safety regulations by validating designs and operational procedures through accurate simulation.
